次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A liquid loses enough heat and becomes solid. Water turning into ice is a familiar example. Melted wax also goes through this change when it cools after a candle is put out.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A solid takes in heat and changes into a liquid. Ice becoming water on a warm day is a common example. The material changes its state rather than becoming a different substance.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Light reaches a surface and changes direction instead of passing through it. This lets you see your face in a mirror. A smooth surface can make the returning light form a clear image.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A straw in a glass of water may look bent at the surface. Light changes direction when passing between air and water. This change also helps lenses bring an image into focus.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Green plants use sunlight to make food from water and carbon dioxide. Oxygen is released during this process. It happens mainly in leaves and helps support much of life on Earth.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A plant is eaten by an insect, which is eaten by a bird. Each living thing passes energy to the next. This connected order shows who eats whom in nature.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Food does not stay in the same form after you swallow it. Your body breaks it into smaller parts that can be taken in. The stomach and intestines help with this process.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A liquid mixture is heated so that part of it becomes gas. The gas is cooled and collected as liquid again. This method can separate substances because they boil at different temperatures.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A mixture is poured through paper with very tiny holes. Liquid passes through, but larger solid pieces stay behind. This method can remove sand from water without making the water boil.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This gas makes up about one fifth of the air. Humans need it to stay alive. It also helps ordinary fires burn, although the gas itself is not a fuel.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People breathe out more of this gas than they breathe in. Plants use it when making food with sunlight. It also forms the bubbles found in many fizzy drinks.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This gas makes up most of the air around us. It has no color or smell. Unlike oxygen, it does not support an ordinary fire, and it is used to help protect packaged food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This is the lightest chemical element. Its gas has no color and can burn when mixed with oxygen. Water contains atoms of this element together with atoms of oxygen.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Living things are made from these tiny units. Some organisms have only one, while your body has many. Each has a boundary, and many contain a central part holding genetic information.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These carry instructions that influence how a living thing develops. Parents pass them to their children. They are parts of DNA and help explain why family members can share certain features.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You start with one number and put another amount with it. The total becomes larger if the second number is positive. A plus sign shows this simple calculation.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You start with an amount and take some of it away. The answer tells you how much remains. A minus sign shows this calculation in a school math book.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You have several groups with the same number of things in each. This calculation finds the total without adding each group separately. Three groups of four give twelve.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You share twelve sweets equally among three children. Each child gets four. This calculation tells you the size of each equal share or how many equal groups you can make.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You can draw this flat shape with three straight lines. It has three corners and three sides. A simple drawing of a mountain or a roof often uses this shape.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Most people have two of these organs near the back of the body. They clean the blood and help control water levels. Waste and extra water leave them as urine.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This flat shape has four straight sides of the same length. All four corners are right angles. A sheet of paper used for Japanese folding art often has this shape.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This flat shape has four sides and four right angles. Opposite sides have the same length. A typical door has this shape, with two long sides and two short ones.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Draw a straight line from one edge of a circle to the other through its center. The length of this line has a special name. It is twice the radius.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This opening looks like a dark circle in the middle of your eye. Light passes through it. It usually becomes smaller in bright light and larger in a dark room.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This is the distance from the center of a circle to its edge. The distance is the same in every direction. When drawing a circle with a compass, you set this length.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Divide the distance around a circle by the distance straight across its center. You always get the same number. In school, students often use three point one four as a simple value.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This way of writing a number shows a part of a whole. One number sits above a line and another below it. One half is a simple example of this form.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This number has digits after a point. It can show an amount smaller than one without using a fraction bar. For example, half can be written as zero point five.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This whole number is greater than one. It can be divided exactly only by itself and one. Two, three, five, and seven are the first few examples of this group.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
To find this value, add all the numbers in a group. Then divide the total by how many numbers there are. Teachers may use it to describe a class's test results.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This measures how much flat space a shape covers. For a rectangle, multiply its length by its width. Answers may use square centimeters instead of ordinary centimeters.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This measures how much three-dimensional space an object takes up. For a rectangular box, multiply length, width, and height. Cubic centimeters are one common unit used for the result.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This angle is the same as the corner of a square. It measures ninety degrees. Builders often check it to make sure two walls meet in the correct way.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two straight lines have this relationship when they stay the same distance apart. Even if they continue forever on a flat surface, they never meet. Railway tracks give a familiar example.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A shape can have this property when its parts match in a balanced way. For one kind, folding along a line makes both sides overlap exactly. A simple butterfly drawing often shows it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many people take pictures of this place in Japan. Its top is often white with snow. You can climb it, but it takes a long time. It is the highest mountain in Japan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This city has many tall buildings and busy trains. The Japanese government works here. You can visit places such as Shibuya and Asakusa in this capital city.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese city has many old temples. It was the home of emperors for a long time. Visitors enjoy its old streets and the golden temple called Kinkakuji.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large Japanese city is famous for funny performers and food. Many visitors walk around Dotonbori. Its famous castle stands in a park, and takoyaki is a popular local snack.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large island is in northern Japan. Winters are cold, and many people go there to ski. Its largest city is Sapporo, which holds a famous snow festival.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese prefecture has warm seas and many islands. It is far south of the main island. Its capital is Naha, and the old Ryukyu Kingdom was here.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This city was once Japan's capital. People visit a very large Buddha at Todaiji Temple. Deer walk freely through its famous park and sometimes bow to visitors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese city has a Peace Memorial Park. An atomic bomb destroyed much of it in 1945. A damaged building called the Atomic Bomb Dome still stands there.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This city is in western Kyushu. It has a long history of contact with other countries. Dejima and Glover Garden are there, and an atomic bomb fell on it in 1945.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This port city is just south of Tokyo. It has a large Chinatown and red brick buildings near the water. A tall building called Landmark Tower is there.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This port city lies between mountains and the sea in western Japan. It is famous for its beef. Its red port tower is a well-known sight near the harbor.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large city lies between Tokyo and Osaka. Its castle has golden fish-like decorations on the roof. It is the capital of Aichi Prefecture in central Japan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This city in northeastern Japan is often called the city of trees. A famous summer festival fills its streets with colorful paper decorations. It is the capital of Miyagi Prefecture.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese city has old streets and a famous garden. Visitors can see Kenrokuen and learn about gold leaf. It is the capital of Ishikawa Prefecture beside the Sea of Japan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large city is in northern Kyushu. Small food stalls open along its streets at night. Hakata is one of its central areas, and its name also names its prefecture.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large lake is in Shiga Prefecture. Its name comes from an old musical instrument. It holds fresh water and is the largest lake by area in Japan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This river flows through central Japan toward the Sea of Japan. Its upper part is called the Chikuma River. When both parts are counted, it is Japan's longest river.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Wind changes the shapes of this sandy place beside the sea. Visitors can walk on large hills of sand. This famous Japanese sight is in Tottori Prefecture.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This shrine stands beside the sea on an island near Hiroshima. At high tide, its large red gate seems to stand in the water. The island is often called Miyajima.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese castle has bright white walls and many roofs. People compare it to a white bird spreading its wings. It stands in Hyogo Prefecture and is called the White Heron Castle.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall structure is painted red and white. People go up it to look over Japan's capital. It opened in 1958 and is 333 meters tall.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This very tall tower stands in Japan's capital. People can enjoy a wide view from high above the streets. It opened in 2012 and is 634 meters tall.
とうきょうスカイツリー

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This temple in Kyoto has a large wooden stage. It stands on a hillside, giving visitors a view of the city. Its name means a temple of clear water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This temple building stands beside a pond in Kyoto. Its upper floors are covered in gold leaf. Visitors often take pictures of the bright building reflected in the water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This shrine in Kyoto has paths covered by many red gates. Fox statues stand around its grounds. Visitors can walk through long tunnels of gates up the mountain.
ふしみいなりたいしゃ

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This colorful shrine is in Tochigi Prefecture. It honors the founder of the Tokugawa shogunate. A famous carving there shows three monkeys covering their eyes, ears, and mouth.
にっこうとうしょうぐう

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This village in Gifu is famous for old farmhouses. Their steep roofs help heavy snow slide off in winter. The roofs look like two hands pressed together in prayer.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This island south of Kyushu gets a lot of rain. Its forests have very old cedar trees and thick green moss. A famous tree there is called Jomon Sugi.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This peninsula is in northeastern Hokkaido. Brown bears live in its wild forests, and ice reaches its coast in winter. Its name is linked to the idea of the end of the land.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This mountain area is in Kumamoto Prefecture. A huge bowl-shaped area surrounds its central peaks, with towns and farms inside. One of its active craters sometimes gives off smoke and gas.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This island country is in eastern Asia. Its flag has a red circle on a white background. It is known for sushi and fast trains, and its capital is Tokyo.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large country is in eastern Asia. A very long old wall runs across parts of its north. Its capital is Beijing, and giant pandas live in its mountains.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country lies across the sea from western Japan. Its music and television shows are popular in many countries. People write in Hangul, and its capital city is Seoul.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large Asian country has many languages and religions. A famous white building called the Taj Mahal stands there. New Delhi is its capital, and many people enjoy cricket.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Southeast Asian country has many beautiful temples. Its traditional new year includes a famous water festival. Bangkok is its capital, and elephants are an important national symbol.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This long, narrow country is in Southeast Asia. Many motorbikes fill its city streets. Its capital is Hanoi, and its flag has a yellow star on a red background.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small country is also a city in Southeast Asia. It has a famous statue with a lion's head and a fish's body. A large hotel there looks like three towers carrying a ship.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Southeast Asian country has thousands of islands. Bali is a famous place for visitors, and Java is another major island. Its flag has red above white.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country lies between Russia and China. Wide grasslands cover much of it, and some families live in round tents. Its famous past leader was Genghis Khan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Asian country lies between India and China. Many mountain climbers visit it to reach very high peaks. Part of Mount Everest is here, and its flag is not rectangular.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country is famous for art and fashion. A tall iron tower stands in its capital city. Its flag has blue, white, and red stripes, and its capital is Paris.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country looks like a boot on a map. Many old Roman buildings stand there. Venice and Florence are famous cities, and its capital is Rome.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country is famous for cars and old castles. A wall once divided its capital city into east and west. That city's name is Berlin.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country shares a large area of land with Portugal. It is known for flamenco and a famous church designed by Gaudi in Barcelona. Madrid is the capital of this European country.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country includes England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Its head of state is a king or queen. London is its capital, and people drive on the left.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country has no coast. Many visitors come to see its mountains and lakes. Its flag is red with a white cross, and the Matterhorn stands on its border.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country has many areas close to sea level. It is famous for windmills and fields of tulips. Many people ride bicycles, and Amsterdam is its capital.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European country has many islands and ancient ruins. The first Olympic Games began here long ago. Its capital is Athens, where an old temple stands on a hill.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country is mostly in northeastern Africa. A long river runs through its dry land. Ancient kings were buried in huge pyramids, and its capital city is Cairo.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This East African country is known for wild animals and long-distance runners. Visitors go on trips to see lions and elephants. Nairobi is its capital city.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country is at the southern end of Africa. Nelson Mandela became its president after spending many years in prison. Cape Town is one of its famous cities.
みなみアフリカきょうわこく

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large country is in North America. Its flag has fifty stars, one for each state. New York and Los Angeles are famous cities, but its capital is Washington, D.C.
アメリカがっしゅうこく

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large country lies north of the United States. Its flag shows a red maple leaf. English and French are official languages, and its capital city is Ottawa.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country lies south of the United States. Ancient Maya ruins can be found here. Its flag shows an eagle holding a snake, and most people speak Spanish.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This is the largest country in South America. People mainly speak Portuguese. A famous carnival takes place in Rio de Janeiro, and much of the Amazon forest is here.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This South American country has high mountains and an ocean coast. The ancient Inca city of Machu Picchu stands here. Its capital is Lima, and the Nazca Lines are also here.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This South American country is very long and narrow. The Pacific Ocean lies on one side and the Andes on the other. Its capital city is Santiago.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This country fills most of a large landmass south of Asia. Kangaroos and koalas live here. Sydney is famous, but its capital city is actually Canberra.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This island country lies southeast of Australia. Its two largest islands are called the North Island and South Island. The kiwi bird is a symbol, and Wellington is its capital.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This continent is extremely cold and covered with ice. Scientists stay at research stations there. It surrounds the South Pole, and penguins live along parts of its coast.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Climbers need special equipment to reach this mountain's top. The air is very thin there. It lies between Nepal and China and is the world's highest mountain above sea level.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This huge dry area covers much of northern Africa. Some parts have sand hills, while others are rocky. It is the largest hot desert in the world.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This enormous river runs through South America toward the Atlantic Ocean. Thick forests grow around it. It carries more water to the sea than any other river.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This long river flows north through northeastern Africa. Ancient Egyptian life depended on its water. It passes through Cairo before reaching the Mediterranean Sea in the north.
